column1: 12.2c Inheritance tax: distribution of claims for business property relief

This table contains data on the distribution of claims at death for business property relief in the 2023 to 2024 tax year. The data is tabulated by the value of the estate's claim (meaning the amount by which the total value of the chargeable estate for IHT purposes is reduced), rather than the value of the asset on which relief was claimed. It does not relate to the value of tax.
